messages:
Olivia Chen: heads up — LHR pop p99 and tail latency started spiking around 2026-03-18 07:05 UTC, seeing ~3x p99 and ~30% throughput drop. locking thread while we triage.
Matt Robinson: noticed it on dashboards too, p99 went from ~45ms -> ~210ms, 1h window. link: https://dash.redwood.company/lhr/latency (internal)
deploy-bot: deploy v2.3.7-kernel-selector rolled to lhr-pop at 2026-03-18T06:45:12Z by ci/canary (id: dpl-8892) :rocket:
Kai Patel: quick profile: increased KV cache evictions correlate with spike. CPU steal low, but net retrans + RTOs up for flows to AS64500 next-hop. snippet from runtime logs:
```
2026-03-18T07:04:52Z [runtime] kernel_selector: chose fallback kernel "heuristic_v2" for model/gpt-small, reason=latency_estimate_oscillation
2026-03-18T07:04:52Z [kvcache] evict: entries=4823 threshold=0.12 miss_rate=0.37
2026-03-18T07:05:01Z [net] tcp: retrans=23 rtt=74ms rttvar=40ms path=AS64500
```
Kai Patel: full flamegraph shows more time in kernel handshake path after selector change, and miss storms cause batching heuristics to degenerate (small batches, more RPCs).
Simon Ng: FYI, IX-LON peering reported congestion and partial route flaps at ~07:00 UTC by provider. ticket: https://status.ix-lon.net/incidents/408 (internal). looks like next-hop AS64500 had capacity issue and increased packet loss for some prefixes.
Maria Santos: opened incident INC-2026-042-LHR-LATENCY, alerting on-calls and customers affected by degraded latency SLA.
Jess Liu: options: 1) roll back kernel-selector heuristic (v2 -> v1) in LHR 2) increase KV cache size / eviction threshold to avoid miss storm 3) apply routing override to avoid AS64500 for critical POPs.
Matt Robinson: prepared rollback patch (revert dpl-8892) but want to be surgical — canary first. also wrote quick config patch to bump eviction threshold:
```
# runtime kvcache tuning
kvcache.eviction_threshold: 0.22  # old:0.12
kvcache.max_entries: 12000       # +30%
batching.min_batch_size: 8       # nudge batching to avoid tiny RPCs
```
Olivia Chen: canary the rollback in 1 host first, then patch kvcache if needed. prefer rollback + routing override if perf doesn't recover.
deploy-bot: started canary rollback to kernel-selector v1 on lhr-host-03 (dpl-8898)
Kai Patel: canary perf after rollback (5m window): p50=18ms p95=76ms p99=120ms on canary host, improved but not fully back to baseline. KV evictions on canary dropped ~70%.
Simon Ng: still seeing some packet loss on AS64500, routing override could shave ~30ms and reduce retrans. happy to apply a temporary BGP preference to avoid AS64500 for LHR POPs.
Jess Liu: go for routing override + kvcache bump across pop if canary stabilizes. also schedule a revert if provider fixes within 6h.
Maria Santos: tracking actions in the incident doc and pager. will notify key customers and update status page.
Olivia Chen: thanks team. next steps: 1) finish kvcache config rollout (Matt) 2) Simon to apply routing override 3) Kai to run 30m perf profile and confirm throughput recovery 4) Maria to draft customer note. I'll own the postmortem.
Matt Robinson: applying config rollout now to 10% hosts in LHR with flag "kvcache-evict-2026-03-18". command: `rbctl rollout set-config --pop lhr --flag kvcache-evict-2026-03-18 --pct 10`
Kai Patel: early numbers at +10%: throughput gap closing to ~10% below baseline, p99 trending down. will post full profile at +30m.
Maria Santos: incident updated, initial impact: increased p99 and throughput drop for ~15% of user requests to EU region, ETA next update 07:45 UTC.
Olivia Chen: keeping thread open until 2h stable. ping me if anything regresses. :white_check_mark:
